'''Emerys''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]] of the [[Shaido]] Clan.

==Strength and Abilities==
Emerys can [[channel]] not very strongly but still with considerable strength. In TWoTC her strength level is described as {{opsl|28}}, which is a middle-high ranking level among [[Aes Sedai]].

This strength can be the minimum needed to open alone a gateway for [[Travel]]ing.

==Activities==
She is one of three Shaido Wise Ones{{ref|The other two being [[Therava]] and [[Sevanna]]}} that visit the Aiel camp in [[Cairhien]] before the events of [[Dumai's Wells]]. Egwene thinks they are spies, but [[Amys]] thinks the suggestion absurd because Wise Ones are protected by tradition and stand apart from conflicts.

She and Therava vouch for Sevanna's status as a Wise One with [[Sorilea]]. Sorilea grumbles, but has no choice but to accept it.
